user_query: Analyze this protein sequence comprehensively. warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Pectinolytic enzymes consist of four classes of enzymes: pectine lyase, polygalacturonase, pectin methylesterase and rhamnogalacturonase. Hydrolyzes alpha-D-galacturonopyranosyl-(1,2)-alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl linkages in the backbone of the hairy regions of pectins.

catalytic_activity.equation: Endohydrolysis of alpha-D-GalA-(1->2)-alpha-L-Rha glycosidic bond in the rhamnogalacturonan I backbone with initial inversion of anomeric configuration releasing oligosaccharides with beta-D-GalA at the reducing end.
catalytic_activity.raw_annotation:
<ns0:comment xmlns:ns0="https://uniprot.org/uniprot" type="catalytic activity">
        <ns0:reaction>
            <ns0:text>Endohydrolysis of alpha-D-GalA-(1->2)-alpha-L-Rha glycosidic bond in the rhamnogalacturonan I backbone with initial inversion of anomeric configuration releasing oligosaccharides with beta-D-GalA at the reducing end.</ns0:text>
            <ns0:dbReference type="EC" id="3.2.1.171" />
        </ns0:reaction>
    </ns0:comment>

similarity: Belongs to the glycosyl hydrolase 28 family.
